Label: Stance_PlunderingFlame_Upgrade2_Description

Label: Stance_PlunderingFlame_Upgrade3_Description

PL: Zachwianie [Burn]Podpalonego wroga odnawia {0}% wszystkich twoich [CD]Blokad (potrojone w przypadku Bossów).

Label: Stance_IceEmperor_Upgrade1_Description

Label: Stance_IceEmperor_Upgrade2_Description
ENG: [D]Damage of first hit to a [Frozen]Frozen enemy is further multiplied x{0}.

Label: Stance_IceEmperor_Upgrade3_Description
ENG: When enemy [Freeze]Freeze reaches {0}% of their remaining [SB]Stagger Bar, they instantly become [Frozen]Frozen.\n\n[Frozen]Freezing enemies also reduces their maximum [H]Health and [SB]Stagger Bar by {0}%.

Label: Stance_Gunslinger_Description

Can only be paired with [Ranged]Ranged Weapon and increases max [Ammo]Ammo to 8.

[BA]Basic Attacks multiply [RD]Damage of next [Ranged]Ranged Technique by [G]x{0}[/G].

You generate {0}[Ammo] every time you Dodge, Riposte or Counter.

Label: Stance_Gunslinger_Upgrade2_Description

Label: Stance_Brawler_Upgrade3_Description

Label: Stance_BodyOfSteel_Description

Label: Stance_BodyOfSteel_Upgrade1_Description

Label: Stance_BodyOfSteel_Upgrade2_Description

Label: Stance_BodyOfSteel_Upgrade2_DescriptionDetailed
ENG: [Barrier]Barrier does not decay while below {0}[Barrier] ({1}% of max [H]Health+[SB]Stagger Bar).

Label: Stance_BodyOfSteel_Upgrade3_Description
ENG: {0}% of [Barrier]Barrier consumed by mitigating [D]Damage restores [H]Health and [SB]Stagger Bar.\n\n{1}% of [Barrier]Barrier decayed without mitigating [D]Damage is converted into [Empowered]Empowered.

Label: Stance_AnatomyExpert_Description
ENG: You convert all [S]Stagger dealt into [I]Injury at 50% effectivness, and all [I]Injury dealt into [Bleed]Bleed at {1}% effectivness, causing you to deal [R]x{2}/R][I]Injury over 30 sec.

Label: Stance_AnatomyExpert_Upgrade1_Description

Label: Stance_AnatomyExpert_Upgrade2_Description

Label: Stance_Assassin_Upgrade1_Description
ENG: [Backstab]Backstab 'Critical Hits' apply {0}[Bleed]Bleed.

ENG: Upon falling below [R]25%[/R][H]Health, gain [Stealth]Stealth ({0} sec) and reset all other [CD]Cooldowns ({1}[CD])

Label: Stance_Assassin_Upgrade3_Description

Label: Stance_CombatBlacksmith_Description

Label: Stance_CombatBlacksmith_Upgrade2_Description

ENG: [Supercharge]Supercharge extra [I]Injury bounces 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing [R]300%[/R], [R]200%[/R], [R]100%[/R][I] and making them flinch ({0}[CD]).\n\nOnly half as effective against single target.

Label: Stance_ElectroCharged_Upgrade3_Description
ENG: When losing more than max [R]20%[/R][H]Health, reduce the [I]Injury by [R]{0}%[/R] of your [Supercharge]Supercharge, and then retaliate with a thunderbolt that inflicts [I]Injury equal to amount blocked ({1}[CD]).

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit
ENG: Power Without Limit
PL: Potęga Bez Granic

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit_FlavorText
ENG: A way to gain greater power through desire that borders on obsession. Given that civilization that developed this ideology disappeared without a trace, perhaps following their teachings might not be the wisest choice.
PL: Sposób pozyskania większej mocy poprzez pożądanie na poziomie obsesji. Patrząc na fakt, że cywilizacja która stworzyła tą ideologię zniknęła bez śladu, być może podążanie ich śladami może nie być najrozsądniejszą decyzją.

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit_Description
ENG: Replace current weapon's move-set with [MD]Magic short-ranged projectiles.\n\nWhen using Techniques, consume all leftover [E]Energy to multiply [D]Damage dealt [G]x{0}[/G] for each [B]100[/B][E] spent.
PL: Używaj [Magic]Magii zamiast obecnej Broni. [BA]Podstawowe Ataki są zasięgowe i nie zużywają amunicji.

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit_Upgrade1_Description
ENG: When gaining [E]Energy, generate extra [B]{0}[/B][E] ({2}[CD]).
PL: Za każdym razem gdy otrzymujesz [E]Energię zyskujesz także [B]10%[/B] swojej maks [E]Energii. (3[CD])

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit_Upgrade1_DescriptionDetailed
ENG: When gaining [E]Energy, generate extra [B]{0}[/B][E] ([B]{0}%[/B] of max [E]Energy, affected by [EG]Energy Gain) ({1}[CD]).
PL: Za każdym razem gdy otrzymujesz [E]Energię zyskujesz także [B]10%[/B] swojej maks [E]Energii. (3[CD])

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit_Upgrade2_Description
ENG: You have +[B]{0}[/B][EG]Energy Gain for each [B]100[/B][E]Energy below max.
PL: Techniki zawsze zużywają całą obecną [E]Energię, ale zadają więcej [D]Obrażeń.

Label: Stance_PowerWithoutLimit_Upgrade3_Description
ENG: When you spend [E]Energy, your max [E]Energy is increased by [B]{0}%[/B] of amount spent until end of combat.\n\nWhile at full [E]Energy, [D]Damage multiplier per [B]100[/B][E]Energy spent is increased to [G]x{1}[/G].
PL: Techniki zawsze zużywają całą obecną [E]Energię. Za każde 1[E]Energii zużytej poza normalnym kosztem, zwiększ [D]Obrażenia Techniki o 4%. Techniki które zużywają różną ilość [E]Energii (takie jak Salwa Energii) zużywają podwójną ilość [E]Energii, ale zadają +200%[D]Obrażeń.

Label: Stance_MindOverMatter
ENG: Mind Over Matter
PL: Umysł Ponad Ciałem

Label: Stance_MindOverMatter_FlavorText
ENG: In recent years, a new ideology started gaining popularity among the Proprius sages. Through discarding worldly desires, they are able to wield energy with even greater proficiency.
PL: Ostatnimi laty nowa ideologia zaczęła stawać się popularna wśród mędrców Proprius. Poprzez odrzucenie ziemskich pokus stają się jeszcze lepsi w kontrolowaniu energii.

Label: Stance_MindOverMatter_Description
ENG: Replace current weapon's move-set with [MD]Magic melee blasts.\n\nMultiply [MD]Damage dealt by [BA]Basic Attacks, [Riposte]Ripostes and [Counters]Counters x{0} for each 100[Analysis]Analysis.
PL: Używaj [Magic]Magii zamiast obecnej Broni. [BA]Podstawowe Ataki są potężnymi, krótko-zasięgowymi uderzeniami.

Label: Stance_MindOverMatter_Upgrade1_Description
ENG: [BA]Basic Attacks give {0}[Analysis].\n\n[Riposte]Ripostes, [Counter]Counters and [Dodge]Dodges give {1}[Analysis].
PL: Twoja statystyka '[EG]Generacja Energii' jest podwojona.

Label: Stance_MindOverMatter_Upgrade2_Description
ENG: Upon dying, consume all [E]Energy to restore %[H]Health equal to [E] spent ({0}[CD]).
PL: Podstawowe Ataki nakładają 10[Analyzed]Przebadany.

Label: Stance_MindOverMatter_Upgrade3_Description
ENG: [Analysis]Analysis is {0}% effective for Techniques from randomly selected Family.\n\nAfter using empowered Techniques from all Families, next Technique's [TD]Damage is multiplied x{1}.
PL: Kiedy miałbyś umrzeć, zamiast [H]Życia zużyj [E]Energię.

Label: ItemSet_Duelist
ENG: Duelist

Label: ItemSet_Duelist_Description
ENG: [Sharp]Sharp, [Riposte]Ripostes, [Counter]Counters

Label: Helmet_Duelist
ENG: Veil of the Clairvoyant

Label: Helmet_Duelist_FlavorText
ENG: When one's sense of sight extends beyond anything humans should be capable of, regular vision is just a hindrance. Unfortunately, it does not matter how far or wide one's sight stretches if the mind cares only about that which is very close by.

Label: Outfit_Duelist
ENG: Dueling Robe
PL: Szata Pojedynkowa

Label: Outfit_Duelist_FlavorText
ENG: Cumbersome armor is not necessary for one who values duels to the death. Even the slightest misstep should always be punished, for being promptly deflected by the armor would rid the duel of all its meaning.

Label: Gloves_Duelist
ENG: Delicate Bracers

Label: Gloves_Duelist_FlavorText
ENG: To master one type of weapon allows one to treat it as if an extension of one's body. If one becomes a human weapon, however, then anything they wield will become such an extension.

Label: Boots_Duelist
ENG: Dueling Shoes
PL: Buty Pojedynkowicza

Label: Boots_Duelist_FlavorText
ENG: In an exchange of blows, being light on your feet can make the difference between life and death. Those who realize this fact will do anything they can do give themselves even the slightest edge.

Label: Longblade_SharpestEdge
ENG: Sharpest Edge

Label: Longblade_SharpestEdge_FlavorText
ENG: One decisive blow can end any duel. So hone your mind, sharpen your senses. A blade of those who truly live for the transcendent moment of overcoming one's opponent and by doing so, overcoming oneself.

Label: TwinBlades_GaleforgedRapier
ENG: Galeforged Rapier

Label: TwinBlades_GaleforgedRapier_FlavorText
ENG: Rapier that belonged to a warrior that went undefeated even after a hundred battles. He met his demise when his loved ones were taken hostage. It was his one weakness that he failed to discover throughout all his duels.

Label: ItemSet_WeaponMaster
ENG: Weapon Master

Label: ItemSet_WeaponMaster_Description
ENG: [Weapons]Weapons, [Technique]Weapon-based Techniques

Label: Helmet_WeaponMaster
ENG: Training Bandana

Label: Helmet_WeaponMaster_FlavorText
ENG: Path to mastery is never ending. But the goal seems well attainable: to carve open a path to a better future.

Label: Outfit_WeaponMaster
ENG: Blademaster's Garb
PL: Strój Mistrza Ostrzy

Label: Outfit_WeaponMaster_FlavorText
ENG: Each weapon has its purpose. Some are inteded for the offensive, while other are quite the contrary. By knowing one's role, one can become that much more effective.

Label: Gloves_WeaponMaster
ENG: Combat Wrappings
PL: Okład Bitewny

Label: Gloves_WeaponMaster_FlavorText
ENG: The path to becoming a weaponmaster typically starts from a very young age. After all, countless years are required to master even one type of weapon. As such, it would require very special circumstances to proficiently wield multiple.

Label: Boots_WeaponMaster
ENG: Master's Sandals
PL: Sandały Mistrza

Label: Boots_WeaponMaster_FlavorText
ENG: On the path to mastery, one is often tempted to treat one's body as nothing more than a tool. But is there a cause grand enough to warrant such a treatment?

Label: ItemSet_Jailer
ENG: Jailer

Label: ItemSet_Jailer_Description
ENG: [Chained]Chained, Empowered by Debuffs

Label: Helmet_Jailer
ENG: Unrelenting Gaol

Label: Helmet_Jailer_FlavorText
ENG: Imprisonment begins in one's mind. Whether it be through addiction, guilt or some other reason, it is a cage one will have great difficulty escaping. After all, it does not take long to mistake the jail as a home.

Label: Outfit_Jailer
ENG: Unfeeling Cage

Label: Outfit_Jailer_FlavorText
ENG: An armor is supposed to protect its owner. But what protection could it ever offer when the wearer does not wish to be protected? And if it is punishment that one desires, then the armor shall oblige.

Label: Gloves_Jailer
ENG: Unending Despair

Label: Gloves_Jailer_FlavorText
ENG: Any jail sentence, no matter how long, ends eventually. Even if that end is death. But what if a jail exists preventing even that final means of escape? Is there any more despair-inducing torture than this?

Label: Boots_Jailer
ENG: Unfulfilled Hope

Label: Boots_Jailer_FlavorText
ENG: One cannot save other, for humans can only save themselves. However, sometimes offering that tiny bit of help is enough, especially when the despair is too much to bear.

Label: Longblade_ObsoleteDiscipline
ENG: Obsolete Discipline

Label: Longblade_ObsoleteDiscipline_FlavorText
ENG: Self-disciple bordering on self-hatred. With no other outlet for regret and frustration, what else can one do. Unfortunately for Iris, she happened to be a brilliant scientist, and her magnum opus was much better form of self-punishment than training with this blade, leading to it being promptly discarded.

Label: TwinBlades_ShacklesOfDuty
ENG: Shackles of Duty
PL: Kajdany Służby

Label: TwinBlades_ShacklesOfDuty_FlavorText
ENG: Being bound by duty does not signify a lack of freedom. After all, there are no tangible chains weighting one down. Every motion, every decision, every sacrifice that one commits: a voluntary choice. Could there ever be a greater expression of freedom?

Label: TwinBlades_WingsOfFreedom
ENG: Wings of Freedom
PL: Skrzydła Wolności

Label: TwinBlades_WingsOfFreedom_FlavorText
ENG: And yet, a time may come when the shackles of duty start feeling cold and foreign. When enforced upon onself by someone else, it stops being a duty and becomes oppresion. And in front of such violence, is there anyone who would not wish to liberate themselves?

Label: Cannon_UnforgivableSin
ENG: Unforgivable Sin

Label: Cannon_UnforgivableSin_FlavorText
ENG: No matter the torment, sacrificing innocent children to just free oneself is an inexcusable sin. After all, how did it make her any different from the evil she so desperately tried to overcome? And so, a weapon was prepared, so that the victim might come here and take their just revenge, if that is their desire.

Label: ItemSet_Ancient
ENG: Ancient

Label: ItemSet_Ancient_Description
ENG: All Stats, Matching Set Synergy

Label: Helmet_Ancient
ENG: Thought Accelerator

Label: Helmet_Ancient_FlavorText
ENG: With sufficient level of technology, Energy Core can be enhanced by special auguments. Only those well-versed in combat can handle such apparatus, and other armaments are required to draw out the equipment's full potential.

Label: Outfit_Ancient
ENG: Security Armor

Label: Outfit_Ancient_FlavorText
ENG: The search for immortality requires many sacrifices. To make sure everything goes according to plan, a powerful security force is required. And it goes without saying that an army without proper equipment would be worthless.

Label: Gloves_Ancient
ENG: Energy Generators

Label: Gloves_Ancient_FlavorText
ENG: One cannot increase the size of one's Energy Core. It can be, however, improved using special equipment. With large enough numbers, an army equipped with such armaments should overcome even the most powerful foe. As it turned out, there are exceptions to every rule.

Label: Boots_Ancient
ENG: Combat Boots

Label: Boots_Ancient_FlavorText
ENG: No matter how well-equipped, no matter how well-trained, how can one contend with a being whose very existence is the fruit of the pursuit of immortality? It is only natural that a simple security force would crumble under the assault.

Label: Gun_AncientFirearms
ENG: Ancient Firearms

Label: Gun_AncientFirearms_FlavorText
ENG: It was not the physical might of the foe that turned the table. 'I shall grant you your deepest desire'. Faced with those words, their hearts wavered, their arms grew feeble. In the end, treachery was their roots from the very beginning.

Label: ItemSet_BattleBorn
ENG: Battle-born

Label: ItemSet_BattleBorn_Description
ENG: [HealthRegeneration]Sustain, Empowered by taking [D]Damage

Label: Helmet_BattleBorn
ENG: Battle Markings

Label: Helmet_BattleBorn_FlavorText
ENG: When chaos ensues, strength and valor are what matter the most. Get the situation under control, save as many as you can. And before long, you will find yourself leading a whole army of people looking up to you.

Label: Outfit_BattleBorn
ENG: Blood-stained Armor

Label: Outfit_BattleBorn_FlavorText
ENG: To protect and serve. The oath that some might have treated as mere formality was still etched deep in her mind. Combined with somewhat juvenile dreams of knights and warriors of old, her course was firmly set.

Label: Gloves_BattleBorn_FlavorText
ENG: The brigther the goal shining ahead, the less one pays attention to what is happening behind their back. That is only to be expected: leading was never something she aspired to do, just something she stumbled into.

Label: Boots_BattleBorn_FlavorText
ENG: In the end, it all comes down to strength. Whether it be physical strength, or the strength to cut down one's valued companion. Were they faced with nothing more but a vile traitor, the deed would have been all that much easier.

Label: Greatsword_Vengeance
ENG: Vengeance
PL: Zemsta

Label: Greatsword_Vengeance_FlavorText
ENG: Some treachery cannot be forgiven. No matter how many years have elapsed, no matter how many generations have passed away. Until all of the traitor's heritage is turned to ash. Until it all burns down.

Label: TwinBlades_BerserkersBlades
ENG: Berserker Blades
PL: Ostrza Berserkera

Label: TwinBlades_BerserkersBlades_FlavorText
ENG: If the traitor shall pass on their teachings, so shall we pass down our pain, our obsession. Until all treachery is punished. Until they too grow to know the pain of betrayal. Even if our sanity is the price.

Label: Gauntlets_HarmonyOfWroughtSteel
ENG: Harmony of Wrought Steel

Label: Gauntlets_HarmonyOfWroughtSteel_FlavorText
ENG: Weapon of choice of those well-versed when it comes to manipulating blood. With this peculliar armament, there shall never be a shortage of blood for those in need of transfusion.

Label: ItemSet_Knight
ENG: Knight

Label: ItemSet_Knight_Description
ENG: [A]Durability, Protection from [Burn]Burn and [Freeze]Freeze

Label: Helmet_Knight
ENG: Gallant Helmet

Label: Helmet_Knight_FlavorText
ENG: Without ideals, strength rules above all. But just one person's moral compass could not possibly sway the whole group. So in the end, it all came down to being the strongest. Once power was within their grasp, whatever title they desired was theirs for the taking.

Label: Outfit_Knight
ENG: Molten Cuirass
PL: Zbroja Płytowa

Label: Outfit_Knight_FlavorText
ENG: Novices of the Ignis style often end up hurting themselves with their own flames. As such, the armor of the Ignis knights was designed to protect from them. After all, who could possibly expect for treachery to come from within one's own ranks?

Label: Gloves_Knight
ENG: Kinslayers
PL: Pogromca Krewnych

Label: Gloves_Knight_FlavorText
ENG: The brighter the light, the darker the shadows. When pushed to the brink, it does not take much for someone to break. All it takes a few sweet words, words that one wanted to hear all along.

Label: Boots_Knight
ENG: Somber Greaves

Label: Boots_Knight_FlavorText
ENG: Once the deed is done, things cannot be the same way they were before. All the responsibilites and pressure are now yours to bear. And never forget that what you have just done can very well be done to you.

Label: ItemSet_Judge
ENG: Judge

Label: ItemSet_Judge_Description
ENG: [Control]Crowd-control, Enemy Lockdown

Label: Helmet_Judge
ENG: Mask of the Judge

Label: Helmet_Judge_FlavorText
ENG: The right to judge is reserved to those standing above the masses. It was their brilliance, their ingenuity that allowed humans to inhabit this continent. And so, it was up to them to decide who would live and who would die.

Label: Outfit_Judge
ENG: Judge's Mantle

Label: Outfit_Judge_FlavorText
ENG: The frustration stemming from what could have been had to be directed somewhere. The fault could not be theirs, for they were infallible. And if so, the fault must have laid with the ignorant masses, too moronic to properly carry out even one simple task.

Label: Gloves_Judge
ENG: Armlets of the Ruler

Label: Gloves_Judge_FlavorText
ENG: Memories did not carry over throughout the years. However, the inherit disdain for those whom they consider below them most certainly did. Too much was lost, too much was taken away. But at least in their own little kingdom, their rule was absolute.

Label: Boots_Judge
ENG: Pride before the Fall

Label: Boots_Judge_FlavorText
ENG: Adults cannot continue to blame their upbrining. As mature, thinking humans, they could have realized the error of their ways. As such, they have only themselves to blame once consequences of their actions came to take their heads.

Label: Daggers_FracturedCleavers
ENG: Fractured Cleavers

Label: Daggers_FracturedCleavers_FlavorText
ENG: The Glacies family was never a monolith they appeared to be. But any dissidents would be promptly dealt with in a most cruel fashion. If even the judges themselves found the actions abhorrent, then what would stop the ignorant masses from doing the same?

Label: Bow_EternalSleep
ENG: Eternal Sleep

Label: Bow_EternalSleep_FlavorText
ENG: Every dissident of the Glacies family had to meet their end. But not every end had to be a cruel one. This weapon was used when a particularly beloved member of the family had to be dealt with. An eternal sleep was the last mercy one was granted as a member of the Glacies.

Label: Gun_JudicalCodex
ENG: Judical Codex

Label: Gun_JudicalCodex_FlavorText
ENG: A weapon granted to the members of the Glacies family on their coming of age ceremony. Justice is what you decide, and whatever you do could not possibly be unjust. There is only one rule that shall never be broken: never judge another member of the Glacies family.

Label: ItemSet_Gunslinger
ENG: Gunslinger

Label: ItemSet_Gunslinger_Description
ENG: [Ranged]Ranged Weapons, [RD]Ranged Damage, [Ammo]Ammo

Label: Helmet_Gunslinger
ENG: Aim Adjuster

Label: Helmet_Gunslinger_FlavorText
ENG: There are those with only partial relations to the Glacies family. Although not treated as full-fledged Judges, they are nonetheless allowed some degree of freedom. And many of them used this freedom to enforce their own brand of justice.

Label: Outfit_Gunslinger
ENG: Gunslinger Garb

Label: Outfit_Gunslinger_FlavorText
ENG: One could hardly ever be as bad as the Judges of the Glacies family, so the so-called 'Gunslingers' were often treated as a breath of fresh air. Most of them roamed the land, settling conflicts according to their own moral compass.

Label: Gloves_Gunslinger
ENG: Leather Bracers

Label: Gloves_Gunslinger_FlavorText
ENG: In the end, solving conflicts always comes down to strength. The strong are just, for they are the ones who write history. Having come to this realization, many Gunslingers were tempted to do what they want, rather than what they think to be just.

Label: Boots_Gunslinger
ENG: Hunter Boots

Label: Boots_Gunslinger_FlavorText
ENG: Why bother with tiresome research and questioning witnesses when all one needs is to follow their gut feeling? At the end of the day, whatever they decide will end up being 'justice' anyway. And so, without even realizing it, they became not much different from their Glacies brethren.

Label: Cannon_Tempest
ENG: Tempest
PL: Nawałnica

Label: Cannon_Tempest_FlavorText
ENG: A weapon crafted by a Gunslinger who spent his childhood training among the Anima warriors. Once he learned of their goal, he could not continue his training there. Their mission was too grand for him. To him, enforcing justice in small doses was more than enough.

Label: Bow_Impetus
ENG: Impetus
PL: Impet

Label: Bow_Impetus_FlavorText
ENG: Weapon crafted and honed by those who favor delivering their justice from afar. There is no better way to send a clear message than having an evildoer pierced by a bolt from seemingly out of nowhere.

Label: Cannon_WraithsEmbrace
ENG: Wraith's Embrace

Label: Cannon_WraithsEmbrace_FlavorText
ENG: Some crimes warrant more than just a simple punishment. The perpetrator has to suffer, otherwise the dead victims cannot pass on to the afterlife. And so, this weapon was created, making sure that there was one bullet saved for just the right target.

Label: ItemSet_Arbiter
ENG: Arbiter

Label: ItemSet_Arbiter_Description
ENG: [S]Stagger, [Staggered]Staggered

Label: Helmet_Arbiter
ENG: Arbiter's Mask

Label: Helmet_Arbiter_FlavorText
ENG: When paying too much attention to the injustice happening far away, one can become blind to the atrocity happening very close. And once the deed is done, there is nothing brute force could possibly solve. And so, searching for even more brute force to enact revenge is all that is left.

Label: Outfit_Arbiter
ENG: Avenger's Perserverance

Label: Outfit_Arbiter_FlavorText
ENG: If there is no justice in this world, then seek it outside. No matter how ardurous the journey. No matter how long it takes. Justice will find its way eventually. So that no more victims will be created.

Label: Gloves_Arbiter
ENG: Just Retribution

Label: Gloves_Arbiter_FlavorText
ENG: The time was kind, and did not steal the vengeance through natural death. And so, the villains shall be judged by their own deeds. The seeds sown throughout the ages have finally ripened. The time of harvest has come.

Label: Boots_Arbiter
ENG: Boots of the Void

Label: Boots_Arbiter_FlavorText
ENG: Revenge is complete, but at what cost? No more victims will be created, but what about those already made? It is too late for regrets, but they come nonetheless. What could have been done different. What could have been improved. Such worthless musings.

Label: Longblade_SwornProtector
ENG: Sworn Protector

Label: Longblade_SwornProtector_FlavorText
ENG: So many years have passed. One small firearms is simply no longer enough to grant protection. And so this blade was created, hoping to make the trials ahead even a bit more bearable.

Label: Gauntlets_MortalityClarified
ENG: Mortality Clarified

Label: Gauntlets_MortalityClarified_FlavorText
ENG: As it turns out, the Judges are humans too. Abundant Energy Cores, powerful Glacies techniques, plethora of legendary weapons: none of those matter in the face of resentment building up over 200 years. And so, they shall be brought down to earth, to realize that they too are mortal.

Label: Gun_PartingGift
ENG: Parting Gift
PL: Obrońca

Label: Gun_PartingGift_FlavorText
ENG: Some issues cannot be solved through regular means. And so, to make the possiblity of a bright future just a bit more likely, an ardorous journey was required. And so this gun was the only memento that remained, so that it may protect its owner against the anyone who wishes them harm.

Label: Gun_Reunion
ENG: Reunion

Label: Gun_Reunion_FlavorText
ENG: There is always a choice. And each choice carries with it certain consequences. Whether to forgive and forget, leaving behind the painful past and focusing on the future. With some of his past finally unveiled, Alex can now decide how to move forward.

Label: Cannon_IceCold
ENG: Ice Cold

Label: Cannon_IceCold_FlavorText
ENG: Simple weaponry would not have been enough. As the original funders, they had access to some of the most advanced technology. And so, outside influence was required. A weapon no member of the Glacies family could have ever seen. A weapon to enact one last judgment.

Label: ItemSet_IronBlooded
ENG: Iron-blooded

Label: ItemSet_IronBlooded_Description
ENG: [H]Health, [A]Durability, Reflect [D]Damage Taken

Label: Helmet_IronBlooded
ENG: Gladiator's Cage

Label: Helmet_IronBlooded_FlavorText
ENG: If you want to survive, then prove it with your blood. Although centuries have passed, this phrase remained etched into the mind of every warrior wearing this helmet. Only strength can save you, so strength is the only thing you need.

Label: Outfit_IronBlooded
ENG: Spike Carapace

Label: Outfit_IronBlooded_FlavorText
ENG: Hurt anyone who approaches. Prevent anyone from touching you. That is the only way to ensure survival, to prevent betrayal. But how can one survive alone, when the whole world is considered an enemy?

Label: Gloves_IronBlooded
ENG: Unity Through Blood

Label: Gloves_IronBlooded_FlavorText
ENG: Not just anyone can become an ally. But those who went through the same pain, through the same torment, could be trusted. Blood does not betray. And so, a certain sense of unity was established.

Label: Boots_IronBlooded_FlavorText
ENG: A family so much more than just parents and their children. A shared purpose, looking out for each other. Although sharing no actual blood connection, they became a family that would last for generations.

Label: Greatsword_Retribution
ENG: Retribution
PL: Odwet

Label: Greatsword_Retribution_FlavorText
ENG: If you hurt others, you need to be prepared to be hurt in return. A pain shared is only half the pain. But will there ever be an end to this vicious cycle when getting hurt is the expected outcome?

Label: ItemSet_Unbreakable
ENG: Unbreakable

Label: ItemSet_Unbreakable_Description
ENG: [SB]Stagger Bar, Blocking, Reflect [D]Damage Blocked

Label: Helmet_Unbreakable
ENG: Helmet of the Unbroken

Label: Helmet_Unbreakable_FlavorText
ENG: Countless years of toil have finally bore fruit. Although still not fully trusted, the family was now valued for their strength and determination. At one point, they were even employed to take part in a secret project, to bolster the already present security forces.

Label: Outfit_Unbreakable
ENG: Steadfast Armor

Label: Outfit_Unbreakable_FlavorText
ENG: Guarding those searching for immortality seemed like a simple enough task. While there were some dissidents, none were strong enough to actually threaten the research project. It would seem like the presence of the Unbreakable would be nothing more than an assurance.

Label: Gloves_Unbreakable
ENG: War Gauntlets

Label: Gloves_Unbreakable_FlavorText
ENG: It takes one mistake to undo years of progress. And it often takes a long time for the true consequences of the decision to come to light. By the time anyone realized what was happening, brute force was completely useless. Escape was the only option.

Label: Boots_Unbreakable
ENG: Mountain Guardians

Label: Boots_Unbreakable_FlavorText
ENG: There were no casualties, but the failure was nonetheless astounding. Driven from their throne, the research team was scattered across the continent, each settling in a separate region best suited to their Energy Core. The Molis family were no exception.

Label: Polearm_Shattershield
ENG: Shattershield
PL: Tarczołamacz

Label: Polearm_Shattershield_FlavorText
ENG: Master of defense knowe fully well how to dismantle said defenses. Momentum of battle can be reversed at any moment. If you never let your enemy out of your sight, there is nothing to fear.

Label: Gauntlets_IronheartSunderers
ENG: Ironheart Sunderers

Label: Gauntlets_IronheartSunderers_FlavorText
ENG: Just protecting oneself cannot solve all problems. Passivity will lead to death sooner or later. And so, a method had to be conceived of translating unbreakable body into an unstoppable force.

Label: ItemSet_Mercenary
ENG: Mercenary

Label: ItemSet_Mercenary_Description
ENG: [Barrier]Barrier, [A]Durability, Anti-Burst

Label: Helmet_Mercenary
ENG: Valiant Protector

Label: Helmet_Mercenary_FlavorText
ENG: Times change. In order not to become obsolete, humans need to adapt. And so the Molis family became known as the greatest Mercenaries, solving issues other families either could not, or were unwilling to personally solve.

Label: Outfit_Mercenary
ENG: Mercenary Armor
PL: Zbroja Najemnika

Label: Outfit_Mercenary_FlavorText
ENG: The Molis family is willing to grant any request. Their reputation is their lifeline, after all. As long as enough money is paid, the contract will be fulfilled. No matter how revolting, no matter how much self-loathing it may end up causing.

Label: Gloves_Mercenary
ENG: Strength of the Mountains

Label: Gloves_Mercenary_FlavorText
ENG: Comradery is forged through blood and struggle. That has been the credo of the Molis family since its inception. And it is exactly because of that reason that hesitation can be born. When a mission drags on for too long, when the target of the mission starts becoming a comrade.

Label: Boots_Mercenary
ENG: Steadfast Steps

Label: Boots_Mercenary_FlavorText
ENG: A day to make a decision will soon come. To decide the right from wrong. To betray one's ideals, or to betray ones family. A culimination of all life's ordeals up until this point. In the end, we are all responsible for our choices. No excuses shall be made.

Label: Greatsword_HollowDrive
ENG: Hollow Drive

Label: Greatsword_HollowDrive_FlavorText
ENG: A greatsword crafted by Alex himself, following a design that came to him in a dream. It is however, lacking the most important central element. And how could it not, when that final part can only be filled with one's own conviction.

Label: Greatsword_Conviction
ENG: Conviction

Label: Greatsword_Conviction_FlavorText
ENG: No longer driven by another's compulsion, Alex was finally able to finish the sword using his own ideals. What those ideals will lead him to do remains to be seen.

Label: Gauntlets_AdamantLotus
ENG: Adamant Lotus

Label: Gauntlets_AdamantLotus_FlavorText
ENG: If I were to fall here, my comrades counting on me would soon follow. And so I have decided to never fall. As long as there is someone to protect, my body shall not break.

Label: ItemSet_Survivor
ENG: Survivor

Label: ItemSet_Survivor_Description
ENG: Survival, [HealthRegeneration]Health Restoration

Label: Helmet_Survivor
ENG: Survivor's Mask

Label: Helmet_Survivor_FlavorText
ENG: Security personel, Researchers, Funders, Engineers: every scientific project requires a wide plethora of expertise. But the pursuit of immortality especially required the knowledge of doctors and health professionals.

Label: Outfit_Survivor
ENG: Protective Suit

Label: Outfit_Survivor_FlavorText
ENG: Unlike researchers or engineers, the doctors were not privy to what was truly happening in the facility. All they could see was a tormented, newborn existence. And so, they naturally offered it their compassion. And so, every single member of the Salutis family survived the catastrophe, even if their memories did not.

Label: Gloves_Survivor
ENG: Iron Vambraces

Label: Gloves_Survivor_FlavorText
ENG: At first, the Salutis medicinal arts were highly sought after. With conflict and wars raging all over the continent, there was a shortage of doctors and nurses. But what point is there in painstakingly curing someone, only to have them get themselves killed the very next day?

Label: Boots_Survivor
ENG: Leather Wings
PL: Skórzane Skrzydła

Label: Boots_Survivor_FlavorText
ENG: Doubts lead to hesitation. Hesitation leads to conflict. And a family could not survive a conflict of such magnitude. In the end, they too succumbed to the first and greatest law of the continent: the law of the strong.

Label: Polearm_SanguineSpike
ENG: Sanguine Spike

Label: Polearm_SanguineSpike_FlavorText
ENG: Mad with grief. Enraged by the betrayal. Even if the target of said treachery does not wish for any more bloodshed. If blood is not spilled, how can one quell the fire raging within?

Label: TwinBlades_Lifebringers
ENG: Lifebringers

Label: TwinBlades_Lifebringers_FlavorText
ENG: Not all doctors of the Salutis family lost their way. But all of them needed a weapon for protection. Only by saving themselves could they start thinking about how to save others.

Label: ItemSet_Assassin
ENG: Assassin

Label: ItemSet_Assassin_Description
ENG: [Stealth]Stealth, [Backstab]Backstabs

Label: Helmet_Assassin
ENG: Night's Veil
PL: Całun Nocy

Label: Helmet_Assassin_FlavorText
ENG: Knowledge of how human body works is obviously useful in more than one line of work. The transistion from doctors to assassins was perfectly smooth. Using subterfuge and poison at first, the Salutis quickly transitioned to other, more personal ways of eliminating dangerous individuals.

Label: Outfit_Assassin
ENG: Assassin's Garb

Label: Outfit_Assassin_FlavorText
ENG: Although their Energy Cores were not as strong as other families, Salutis managed to stand their ground through clever use of techniques and avoiding face-to-face confrontations. They became both reviled and respected, a reputation that was not much different from their time as doctors.

Label: Gloves_Assassin
ENG: Silencers

Label: Gloves_Assassin_FlavorText
ENG: There is a certain unexplained circumstance behind the Salutis family success. Whenever they were about to suffer a mortal injury, by some twist of fate they would end up escaping unscathed. Before long, rumours started spreading that an invisible deity was guarding the assassins.

Label: Boots_Assassin
ENG: Silent Steps

Label: Boots_Assassin_FlavorText
ENG: The steps of the Salutis family were naturally guided towards assisting Drake. It was not out of fear that their good fortune would end, their invisible deity angered. They simply decided to purge what was wrong, the excise the source of the original sin. Just like a doctor would cut out the cancer killing the body.

Label: Longblade_EclipseBoundary
ENG: Eclipse Boundary

Label: Longblade_EclipseBoundary_FlavorText
ENG: The Salutis family is not a death cult. True to their roots, they cherish life beyond anything else. And that is exactly the reason why they allied themselves with an entity aiming to erase the continent from existence. The results of the research must not get to the outside world, for the sake of all life beyond this place.

Label: Daggers_DragonsClaws
ENG: Dragon's Claws

Label: Daggers_DragonsClaws_FlavorText
ENG: Without sufficient physical strength, fine armaments are required to break through the body of particularly strong Enforcers. Those who lack the qualities of hero would surely fall victim to the claws of the dragon they set out to hunt.

Label: Daggers_OnyxShards
ENG: Onyx Shards

Label: Daggers_OnyxShards_FlavorText
ENG: Certain targets cannot be allowed to escape with their Energy Core unscathed. Fortunately, masters of medicinal arts came up with a method of neutralizing said danger. A technique that Alex ended up picking up as well.

Label: Cannon_Veilbreaker
ENG: Veilbreaker

Label: Cannon_Veilbreaker_FlavorText
ENG: The veil of shadows provides not only protection, but also an ample opportunity for an ambush. It was only a matter of time before the Salutis assassins created a weapon capable of amplifying that offensive capability.

Label: ItemSet_Executioner
ENG: Executioner

Label: ItemSet_Executioner_Description
ENG: [I]Injury, Takedowns

Label: Helmet_Executioner
ENG: Executioner's Amplifier

Label: Helmet_Executioner_FlavorText
ENG: Frailty of the Energy Core could be made up for using the right equipment. If one were to champion the cause of saving the lives, no matter how mired in sin they might be, then one would need a way to fight openly, without relying on the safety of shadows.

Label: Outfit_Executioner
ENG: Hallowed Armor

Label: Outfit_Executioner_FlavorText
ENG: It is no easy feat to go against the teaching of one's family. But countless innocent lives is too big of a price to pay for a sin commited hundreds of years ago. That much should be plain for anyone to see, so why was she standing alone?

Label: Gloves_Executioner
ENG: Unwavering Resolve

Label: Gloves_Executioner_FlavorText
ENG: Strength of will is not enough to solve all problems. Sadly, not everyone is predisposed to taking the center stage. Despite their best intentions, some people will be relegated to the role as a supporting actor.

Label: Boots_Executioner_FlavorText
ENG: All kinds of roles need to be fulfilled in the quest to save the world. Instead of cursing fate, one should strive to fulfill their role as best as they can. Being a supporting role does not make one any less important.

Label: Longblade_Reaper
ENG: Reaper

Label: Longblade_Reaper_FlavorText
ENG: All members of the Salutis family assume that their control over shadows is granted to them by some mysterious entity particularly favorable to them. Clarise, however, went against her family's teachings, and yet retained said powers. Perhaps the power to control shadows is in their blood, just like control over fire is the domain of the Ignis.

Label: Gun_Lament
ENG: Lament
PL: Lament

Label: Gun_Lament_FlavorText
ENG: Going against one's family, or going against one's beliefs? It is difficult to say which is more painful. But once a decision is made, one should stick to it until the very end.

Label: ItemSet_Artisan
ENG: Artisan

Label: ItemSet_Artisan_Description
ENG: Empowering Items, Empowering Tools

Label: Helmet_Artisan
ENG: Craftsman's Glasses

Label: Helmet_Artisan_FlavorText
ENG: Analyzing the internal structure of an object is a crucial part of the creation process. Since time immemorial the Tonitrui engineers have seen the world through the lens of such artefacts, always searching for a solution to every problem.

Label: Outfit_Artisan
ENG: Artist's Garb

Label: Outfit_Artisan_FlavorText
ENG: Inventing new technology is so much more than just science. It is an art, an endevaour that requires offering every ounce of creativity one possesses. Without such dedication, the pursuit of immortality would be nothing more than a pipe dream.

Label: Gloves_Artisan
ENG: Engineer's Gloves.

Label: Gloves_Artisan_FlavorText
ENG: There is only so much a skilled engineer can do when the premise itself is flawed. Control over the whole system had been granted to a hostile individual despite the vehement objections. Was getting results here and now truly so important?

Label: Boots_Artisan
ENG: Pursuit of Perfection

Label: Boots_Artisan_FlavorText
ENG: A true scientist would have understood that entrusting the research to future generations was preferable over taking such monumental risks. But in the end, fear of death clouded the judgment of the wealthy, leading to the whole project going up in flames.

Label: ItemSet_Alacrity
ENG: Alacrity

Label: ItemSet_Alacrity_Description
ENG: [SP]Movement Speed, [AS]Attack Speed

Label: Helmet_Alacrity
ENG: Enhancing Mask

Label: Helmet_Alacrity_FlavorText
ENG: Scientific pursuits alone are not enough to carve a place in a continent ruled by strength. In order to secure a place for themselves after the collapse, and to one day break the barrier to the outside world, the Tonitrui family would need to develop combat techniques.

Label: Outfit_Alacrity
ENG: Acceleration Suit

Label: Outfit_Alacrity_FlavorText
ENG: Electricty can be used to power various machines, but as Tonitrui's interest turned towards combat, they soon found themselves using it for enhancing their own bodies instead. Lacking the brute force of Ignis or Molis, they had to rely on speed instead.

Label: Gloves_Alacrity
ENG: Thunder Gloves

Label: Gloves_Alacrity_FlavorText
ENG: Although their focus turned towards combat, Tonitrui did not forget their roots as engineers and inventors. Those signature gloves allows them to excel at both, elevating their prestige in both fields.

Label: Boots_Alacrity
ENG: Light Steps

Label: Boots_Alacrity_FlavorText
ENG: In the end, the time to decide the fate of the continent has come. The aim is to reach beyond the wall of storms, into the world byeond. Although they may be allied with Drake on the surface, it is only a means to an end.

Label: Daggers_ZephyrsTalons
ENG: Zephyr's Talons

Label: Daggers_ZephyrsTalons_FlavorText
ENG: Although often given a fancy name, almost all Enforcer weapons are the result of long and exhausting research. Not unlike shoes, one has to use the ones that fit them just right. The outlier here is Alex, who is for some reason perfectly capable of wielding vastly differing weapons without any issue.

Label: Daggers_StilettoSeriesMark3
ENG: Stiletto Series Mark 3

Label: Daggers_StilettoSeriesMark3_FlavorText
ENG: Not all projects can be finished, and so not all weapons can ascend into being a tool of an Enforcer. And yet, this specific pair of blades, although abandoned a long time ago, has been properly finished. And yet it remains unnamed, once again abandoned despite being completed. Perhaps the journey was more important than the destination?

Label: ItemSet_Enforcer
ENG: Enforcer

Label: ItemSet_Enforcer_Description
ENG: [Onslaught]Onslaught, [BA]Basic Attacks

Label: Helmet_Enforcer
ENG: Enforcer's Mask

Label: Helmet_Enforcer_FlavorText
ENG: Due to their expertise, the Tonitrui never had any issue amassing wealth and connections. The value of those, however, pale in comparison to brute, overwhelming strength. As such, it led the Tonitrui family to pursue unaffiliated Enforcers much more aggresively than other families.

Label: Outfit_Enforcer
ENG: Combat Suit

Label: Outfit_Enforcer_FlavorText
ENG: Enforcers are much more likely to be born within already established families, with a similar aptitude to one's parents. As such, most Enforcers are born and stay within their families, avoiding the risk of their techniques leaking outside. Tonitrui, however, possessed few techniques of their own, forcing them to partially rely on outsiders.

Label: Gloves_Enforcer
ENG: Tyrant Gauntlets

Label: Gloves_Enforcer_FlavorText
ENG: Strength turns into confidence. Confidence turns into pride. And pride most often leads to hubris. Assured of their own power and armed with powerful equipment, many Enforcers started exerting more and more influence on the Tonitrui family's policies. And when Drake came to make an offer, it was the Enforcers who made sure it would not be refused.

Label: Boots_Enforcer
ENG: Augumented Greaves

Label: Boots_Enforcer_FlavorText
ENG: In the end, the Tonitrui family allied themselves with Drake just as Salutis and Molis have. And under regular circumstances, so would have Alex. But this time around, Drake's proposal was not enough to sway him. For the first time in his life, Alex would not be a simple tool swung around by someone else.

Label: Greatsword_SteelWarden
ENG: Steel Warden

Label: Greatsword_SteelWarden_FlavorText
ENG: Although working under the same family, the Tonitrui Enforcers made sure to keep their contact to an absolute minimum. For all their faults, it was their biggest victory that they were able to acknowledge their fault and work around it. No room would be big enough to accomodate two overinflated egos.

Label: Polearm_Hurricane
ENG: Hurricane
PL: Huragan

Label: Polearm_Hurricane_FlavorText
ENG: Complicated techniques and keen battle sense is not necessary for an Enforcer's everyday life. Their bodies are much stronger than an average human's. When executed by them, even a simple swing becomes an unstoppable attack. Why waste time on useless training when the world is already at one's feet?

Label: TwinBlades_Oath
ENG: Oath

Label: TwinBlades_Oath_FlavorText
ENG: When coming under the Tonitrui family, one is gifted a weapon designed specially for them to remind of the newly forged connection. It was Laura who made this pair of blades and gifted them to Alex. Even the connection was severed, Alex never considered discarding such a perfectly fine weapon.

Label: TwinBlades_RestoredVow
ENG: Restored Vow

Label: TwinBlades_RestoredVow_FlavorText
ENG: To err is to be human. No matter how brilliant, each and every person is prone to making mistakes. But it is the duty of a friend to help each other stand up again when the mistake occurs. Running away from the whole situation is never the right response.

Label: ItemSet_Sage
ENG: Sage

Label: ItemSet_Sage_Description
ENG: [Magic]Magic, [EG]Energy Gain, [CDR]Cooldown Reduction

Label: Helmet_Sage
ENG: Sage Shroud
PL: Całun Mędrca

Label: Helmet_Sage_FlavorText
ENG: In the pursuit of knowledge, one needs to be prepared to make some sacrifices. Even moreso than that, one needs to acknowledge that the fruit of one's labour would be harvested only by the future generations. Haphazard pursuit of immortality goes against the Proprius family's beliefs... but the end-result, no matter how catastrophical, was well worth recording.

Label: Outfit_Sage
ENG: Mystic's Robe

Label: Outfit_Sage_FlavorText
ENG: The final result was nothing surprising. True immortality is no doubt beyond human reach, and the pale imitation that was discovered was an affront to life as a whole. However, just as expected, the catastrophic downfall of the project brought with it some interesting revelations.

Label: Gloves_Sage
ENG: Inner Flow

Label: Gloves_Sage_FlavorText
ENG: The shadow was in no way immortal. Such primitive means cannot escape the constraints of entropy. It would perish within mere 200 years, give or take. As such, the duty of the Proprius family was to record the results of the experiment and leave that information to the future generations. Even if the Proprius family itself were to perish as a result.

Label: Boots_Sage
ENG: Hermit's Patience

Label: Boots_Sage_FlavorText
ENG: Not everyone is willing to give up their life in pursuit of science. That is natural behavior, even if not befitting a member of the Proprius family. As such, despite being the heir of the Proprius family, Drake was forced to look elsewhere for allies if he were to stop the Shadow's plans.

Label: ItemSet_RoyalGuard
ENG: Royal Guard

Label: ItemSet_RoyalGuard_Description
ENG: [Technique]Techniques, [EG]Energy Gain, [CDR]Cooldown Reduction

Label: Helmet_RoyalGuard
ENG: Guardian Helmet

Label: Helmet_RoyalGuard_FlavorText
ENG: To give up one's life for the sake of science is one's personal choice. Not everyone is as commited to such pursuits as the leaders of the Proprius family. And yet, the regular members could not possibly express their opinion. For to put one's own life above science was tantamount to rejecting the Proprius family.

Label: Outfit_RoyalGuard
ENG: Azure Breastplate

Label: Outfit_RoyalGuard_FlavorText
ENG: Just any regular member of the Proprius family expressing their opinion would have been laughable. But things were different when it was the heir apparent who had done so. Drake went against the very principles driving the Proprius family, and by doing so, promised survival to those in despair.

Label: Gloves_RoyalGuard
ENG: Royal Protector

Label: Gloves_RoyalGuard_FlavorText
ENG: A sizable part of the Proprius family followed after Drake into the main continent. They called themselves 'The Royal Guard', for to them, Drake was their king. Drake himself would never acknowledge such a title, of course, so they were forced to only use the title when out of his earshot.

Label: Boots_RoyalGuard
ENG: Will To Survive

Label: Boots_RoyalGuard_FlavorText
ENG: Being a part of Drake's elite squad was a source of immense pride. And said pride was being trampled on every time Drake looked elsewhere for solution to his problems. Was someone like Alex Wester truly necessary to solve the problems plaguing the continent?

Label: Longblade_ArcaneSword
ENG: Arcane Sword

Label: Longblade_ArcaneSword_FlavorText
ENG: The Proprius family higher-ups never lowered themselves to relying on physical weapons. No longer bound by such pointless traditions, the Royal Guard were able to arm themselves with steel that perfectly conducted their Energy-based techniques.

Label: ItemSet_ShadowGifted
ENG: Shadow-gifted

Label: ItemSet_ShadowGifted_Description
ENG: [D]Damage over time, [Effect]Stacking Effects

Label: Helmet_ShadowGifted
ENG: Glimpse of the Future

Label: Helmet_ShadowGifted_FlavorText
ENG: Shadow-gifted is such an inaccurate term. Drake's vision of the future was no gift, for he paid for it in full. It was a purely transactual relationship, and as such, is bound to change at any moment. And said moment came when Drake realized the Shadow's true intentions regarding the continent.

Label: Outfit_ShadowGifted
ENG: Hero's Vest

Label: Outfit_ShadowGifted_FlavorText
ENG: Saving the world is too daunting of a task to be accomplished alone. But only Enforcers are strong enough to have any say in the matter. While certainly reliable, Drake's elite squad lacked the power to challenge the Shadow. When it comes to brute force, only one name came to Drake's mind, a tyrant from a future that would never come to pass.

Label: Gloves_ShadowGifted
ENG: United Strength

Label: Gloves_ShadowGifted_FlavorText
ENG: When seen through the veil of precognition's vision, Alex Wester seemed like a mysterious yet ruthless dictator. He charted a course to a destination only he could see, and he accepted no dissidents. His determination and power could not be denied, and those were qualities that Drake so desperately needed.

Label: Boots_ShadowGifted
ENG: Saviour's Greaves

Label: Boots_ShadowGifted_FlavorText
ENG: Preconceptions and reality often do not match. The Alex Wester that Drake met turned out more of a victim than a tyrant. A simple tool being used by everyone around him, and now it was Drake's turn. As such, Drake did not hesitate to abandon everything he accomplished. In order to truly save the world, not a single person could be forsaken.

Label: Polearm_AzureMoon
ENG: Azure Moon

Label: Polearm_AzureMoon_FlavorText
ENG: This is a weapon that should not exist. At least, 'not yet'. But thanks to Drake's memories, he was able to recreate Laura's gift, a commemoration of the start of their friendship. Although Drake hated a lot of what he saw in his vision of the future, there were some things he could not bring himself to throw away.

Label: Cannon_Frostfire
ENG: Frostfire

Label: Cannon_Frostfire_FlavorText
ENG: Ignis and Glacies have often clashed. Self-proclaimed enforcers of law versus self-proclaimed judges. And yet, the nature of their energies were quite compatible, leading to the creation of this weapon despite the protests of both families.

Label: ItemSet_Unique
ENG: Unique

Label: ItemSet_Unique_Description
ENG: Special effects

Label: Greatsword_Reckoning
ENG: Reckoning

Label: Greatsword_Reckoning_FlavorText
ENG: One of Laura and Alex's countless creations. It was sealed in stone as part of a bet which Alex ended up losing. Once he returned after 8 years, he was strong enough to take it out by force. It was, however, a hollow victory.

Label: Greatsword_DragonsMaw
ENG: Dragon's Maw
PL: Smocza Paszcza

Label: Greatsword_DragonsMaw_FlavorText
ENG: There are various vessels for temporarily holding a soul. A suit of armor, a greatsword, the moon itself, or in one specific example even a human's body. What all those things have in common is that the process is merely temporary. Everything perishes eventually.

Label: Greatsword_Plunderer
ENG: Plunderer
PL: Grabieżca

Label: Greatsword_Plunderer_FlavorText
ENG: A weapon wielded by the Ignis family heads since its very inception. It has the power of stealing the energy of others, which supports the notion that plundering is the core concept on which the Ignis family was built.

Label: Longblade_Severance
ENG: Severance
PL: Rozcięcie

Label: Longblade_Severance_FlavorText
ENG: An ancient weapon, once used to hunt massive and dangerous monsters roaming the continent. Although all the beasts are gone, it is now needed more than ever, with tyranous Enforcers replacing the monsters of old.

Label: Polearm_Javelin
ENG: Javelin
PL: Oszczep

Label: Polearm_Javelin_FlavorText
ENG: A type of polearm that can be used as both melee and thrown weapon. The original prototype was wielded by a peculiar Tonitrui warrior who could endlessly copy the weapon he wielded, providing himself with endless ammunition.
PL: Broń, która może być używana zarówno do walki wręcz, jak też jako broń miotana. Oryginalny prototyp był dzierżony przez nietypowego wojownika Tonitrui, który mógł bez końca duplikować swoją broń, zapewniając sobie niewyczerpaną amunicję.

Label: Polearm_Harpoon
ENG: Harpoon
PL: Harpun

Label: Polearm_Harpoon_FlavorText
ENG: A tool used by fishermen inhabiting the Anima Islands. As it turns out, it can also be used to hunt bigger prey, and became a weapon of choice for many fishermen who ended up becoming Anima warriors.

Label: Polearm_ChargeLance
ENG: Charge Lance
PL: Lanca Ładunkowa

Label: Polearm_ChargeLance_FlavorText
ENG: Commonly called the 'Skewerer', this spear is infamous for being used by particularly tyrranical Enforcers. Supposedly the wielders often held competition as to how many 'weaklings' they can 'skewer' before the lance runs out of charged power.

Label: TwinBlades_DawnAndDusk
ENG: Dawn and Dusk
PL: Świt i Zmierzch

Label: TwinBlades_DawnAndDusk_FlavorText
ENG: Knocking enemy off balance and striking their weak spots are two sides of the same coin. Only one who utilizes both in equal measures can utilize everything that swordsmanship has to offer.
PL: Wytrącanie wroga z równowagi i uderzanie w jego słabe punkty to dwie strony tej samej monety. Tylko ten, który może korzystać z obu jest w stanie wykorzystać wszystko, co szermierka ma do zaoferowania.

Label: Daggers_CrimsonCarvers
ENG: Crimson Carvers

Label: Daggers_CrimsonCarvers_FlavorText
ENG: A set of peculiarly shaped blades, used by the more eccentric of Salutis assassins. The fact that deep Bleeds made by this weapon cannot land a killing blow might be connected to its original use as medical equipment.
PL: Para ostrzy o nietypowym kształcie, używane głównie przez bardziej ekscentrycznych zabójców Salutis. Fakt, że głębokie rany zadane tą bronią nie prowadzą do wykrwawienia może mieć związek z historią tych ostrz jako medycznego wyposażenia.

Label: Daggers_VipersFangs
ENG: Vipers Fangs

Label: Daggers_VipersFangs_FlavorText
ENG: Those oddly shaped knives are a relic of an unknown era. When energy is poured into those, they transform said energy into potent poison. As a result, throughout history they were most often used as a poison mass-factory.

Label: Gauntlets_Shatterers
ENG: Shatterers
PL: Roztrzaskiwacze

Label: Gauntlets_Shatterers_FlavorText
ENG: Even the hardest rock can by crushed when showered with enough punches. Often favored by the Enforcers of the Molis family, those gauntlets seem to embody the idea that as long as the user refuses to fall, their enemy is bound shatter sooner or later.

Label: Gauntlets_AshenDiscord
ENG: Ashen Discord

Label: Gauntlets_AshenDiscord_FlavorText
ENG: Humans will always fight for more power, more control. Even if their very existence is at stake. Even if the lives of everyone they know are in peril. In the end, selfishness and lack of trust is the greatest crisis humanity could possibly face.

Label: Gauntlets_PiercingThorns
ENG: Piercing Thorns

Label: Gauntlets_PiercingThorns_FlavorText
ENG: Those who put too much confidence into their defenses, adamant that nothing could possibly break past them, will sooner or later receive a wake-up call. The only thing one can truly trust are the skills they acquired through countless duels.

Label: Bow_Barrage
ENG: Barrage
PL: Ogień Zaporowy

Label: Bow_Barrage_FlavorText
ENG: This weapon was created by an Enforcer who was frustrated with the bow's slow charge-up speed. Instead of switching to firearms, he invented a completely new type of bow.
PL: Ta broń została stworzona przez Autarchę, który był sfrustrowany jak wolno łuk ładuje energię. Zamiast zacząć używać broni palnej, wynalazł on zupełnie nowy typ łuku.

Label: Bow_Ebony
ENG: Ebony
PL: Heban

Label: Bow_Ebony_FlavorText
ENG: A mass produced bow, it is known as a weapon with low potential. However, only someone who invests precious materials into upgrading it will know its true power.
PL: Masowo produkowany łuk, powszechnie uważa się, że ma mały potencjał. Tylko ten, kto zainwestuje w niego cenne materiały dowie się, jaką naprawdę skrywa moc.

Label: Bow_EmberleafShortbow
ENG: Emberleaf Shortbow

Label: Bow_EmberleafShortbow_FlavorText
ENG: Sometimes, one greatly placed shot can turn the tide of battle. It is even moreso for duels, when having a hidden weapon up one's sleeve can make all the difference in the world.

Label: Bow_ForgottenFang
ENG: Forgotten Fang

Label: Bow_ForgottenFang_FlavorText
ENG: The Tonitrui have always been capable of creating fragile and temporary copies of items they have analyzed. Laura is the first one to take that craft to a whole new level. If her Energy Core was still intact, it would no doubt become her most formidable technique.

Label: Bow_HeartPiercer
ENG: Heart Piercer

Label: Bow_HeartPiercer_FlavorText
ENG: Breaking one's Energy Core is an incredibly complicated procedure. Only someone skilled in all sorts of different techniques could possibly pull it off. Most Enforcers do not bother with such trifles. After all, piercing the heart is all one needs to stop the enemy from moving.

Label: Gun_TwinSymphony
ENG: Twin Symphony

Label: Gun_TwinSymphony_FlavorText
ENG: Human body and their Energy Core work in tandem to assist in combat. Most warriors focus on targeting one or the other. This unique weapon allows to damage both at the same time, punishing those with glaring weaknesses.

Label: Gun_Revolver
ENG: Revolver
PL: Rewolwer

Label: Gun_Revolver_FlavorText
ENG: Weapon of choice for swordsmen who wish to give themselves any edge they can. They soften their opponents with a ranged barrage, only to switch to melee combat once they run out of bullets.

Label: Gun_Twilight
ENG: Twilight

Label: Gun_Twilight_FlavorText
ENG: The difference between light and dark is clear cut. Unfortunately, that is not the case for a lot of other things in life. One can have difficulty telling truth apart from lies, or good apart from evil.

Label: Cannon_Convergence
ENG: Convergence

Label: Cannon_Convergence_FlavorText
ENG: In order to hurt others, one has to be prepared to be hurt in turn. Those who have wielded overwhelming strength since they were born are often lacking in such resolve, quickly crumbling once faced with someone capable of standing up to them.

Label: Tool_FortificationPotion
ENG: Fortification Potion
PL: Mikstura Stabilności

Label: Tool_FortificationPotion_FlavorText
ENG: With the passage of time, techniques targeting enemy Energy Cores became more and more prevalent, requiring to expand the repertoire of flasks to include a fitting counter-measure.

Label: Tool_FortificationPotion_Description
ENG: Restore {0}[SB]Stagger Bar over {1} seconds.
PL: Odzyskaj {0}[SB]Pasku Zachwiania w przeciągu {1} sekund.

Label: Tool_Caltrops
ENG: Caltrops
PL: Kotewki

Label: Tool_Caltrops_FlavorText
ENG: Salutis assassin's job does not conclude the moment their target is dispatched. They also need to return alive, or else the mission can only be considered a failure. Tools such as these often help accomplish this daunting task.

Label: Tool_Caltrops_Description
ENG: Spread {0} caltrops. Enemy stepping on them suffer [R]{1}[/R][Bleed]Bleed and {2}[Slow]Slow.
PL: Rozsyp {0} kotewek. Wrogowie nadeptujący na nie otrzymują [R]{1}[/R][Bleed]Nacięcie i {2}[Slow]Spowolnienia.

Label: Tool_SerenityNeedle
ENG: Serenity Needles

Label: Tool_SerenityNeedle_FlavorText
ENG: Upon encountering the 'Eternal Sleep' weapon used by the Glacies, the Salutis assassins immediately realized a more practical way of using the weapon's effect, and tasked the Tonitrui with creating a suitable tool. The genius inventors did not disappoint.

Label: Tool_SerenityNeedle_Description
ENG: Throw a needle that inflicts [Sleep]Sleep for {0} seconds upon hit.
PL: Rzuć igłą która nakłada [Sleep]Uśpienie na {0} sekund przy trafieniu.

Label: Tool_Sanctuary
ENG: Sanctuary Stone
PL: Kamień Azylu

Label: Tool_Sanctuary_FlavorText
ENG: Some special minerals are capable of storing vast amounts of energy. While the Combat Expert badges store pure and undiluted version, stones such as these instead specialize in evoking a layer of energy specialized in self-preservation.

Label: Tool_Sanctuary_Description
ENG: For next {0} seconds, all [D]Damage you take is decreased by {1}.
PL: Przez następne {0} sekund, wszystkie [D]Obrażenia które otrzymasz zostaną zmniejszone o {1}.

Label: Tool_CrimsonFeather
ENG: Crimson Feather
PL: Szkarłatne Pióro

Label: Tool_CrimsonFeather_FlavorText
ENG: The Tonitrui latest and possibly most coveted invention, although as it turned out, only few select individuals were actually able to get those feathers to work. Fortunately, Alex turned out to be part of said group.

Label: Tool_CrimsonFeather_Description
ENG: When you have this tool equipped, it will be automatically used once your [H]Health falls to 0, causing you to restore {0}[H]Health.

Label: Tool_ExpertBadge
ENG: Enforcer Badge
PL: Odznaka Autarchy

Label: Tool_ExpertBadge_FlavorText
ENG: Combat Experts are Enforcers employed to aid with law enforcement. Although no less powerful, they do not enjoy as much prestige as the Ignis knights, leading to much friction between the two organizations.

Label: Tool_ExpertBadge_Description
ENG: Gain {0}[E]Energy. [CD]Cooldown permanently increases by [GREY]{1}[/GREY] sec until end of mission.
PL: Otrzymaj {0}[E]Energii. [CD]Blokada zwiększa się na stałe o [GREY]{1}[/GREY] sek do końca misji.

Label: Tool_VacuumGrenade
ENG: Vacuum Grenade
PL: Granat Próżniowy

Label: Tool_VacuumGrenade_FlavorText
ENG: One of countless experimental weapons Alex created together with Laura. As years passed, Alex ended up perfecting the design and could actually start using the grenades in combat scenarios.

Label: Tool_VacuumGrenade_Description
ENG: Throw a grenade that deals {0}[I]Injury and {1}[S]Stagger to nearby enemies. Hitting only 1 enemy deals extra {2}[S]Stagger. Hitting more than 1 enemy applies [Stun]Stun ({3} sec).
PL: Rzuć granat zadający {0}[I]Zranienia i {1}[S]Zachwiania pobliskim wrogom. Trafienie tylko 1 wroga zadaje dodatkowe {2}[S]Zachwiania. Trafienie więcej niż 1 wroga nakłada [Stun]Ogłuszenie ({3} sek).

Label: Tool_VacuumGrenade_DescriptionDetailed
ENG: Throw a grenade that deals {4}[I]Damage to first enemy hit. Upon hit or after 1 second it explodes, dealing {0}[I]Damage and {1}[S]Stagger in 2m radius. If only one enemy was hit, deal extra {2}[S]Stagger. If more than one enemy was hit, inflict [Stun]Stun ({3} sec) on all enemies.
PL: Rzuć granat zadający {4}[I]Obrażeń pierwszemu trafionemu przeciwnikowi. Eksploduje po trafieniu lub 1 sek, zadając {0}[I]Obrażeń i {1}[S]Zachwiania w promieniu 2m. Jeśli trafiony został tylko 1 wróg, zadaj dodatkowo {2}[S]Zachwiania. Jeśli trafionych zostało więcej wrogów, nałóż [Stun]Ogłuszenie ({3} sek) na wszystkich trafionych wrogów.

Label: Tool_StunGrenade
ENG: Stun Grenade
PL: Granat Ogłuszający

Label: Tool_StunGrenade_FlavorText
ENG: Although only useful against weaker enemies, this type of equipment is popular among novice Enforcers. When surrounded by an army of weaker opponents, it allows to create an opening to escape.

Label: Tool_StunGrenade_Description
ENG: Throw a grenade that applies [Stun]Stun ({0} sec) on all regular enemies within {1}m range.

Label: Tool_StunGrenade_DescriptionDetailed
ENG: Throw a grenade that applies [Stun]Stun ({0} sec) on all regular enemies within {1}m range. Stun duration is decreased up to 50% depending on distance. Boss enemies only flinch

Label: Tool_FireStarter
ENG: Fire Starter
PL: Podpalacz

Label: Tool_FireStarter_FlavorText
ENG: Originally created in order to start campfires, it was quickly discovered that overloading it with energy could create massive explosions. A lot of research went into creating an article that could be used more than once.
PL: Początkowo stworzony w celu rozpalania ognisk, szybko odkryto że przeciążenie go energią prowadzi do wytworzenia ogromnej eksplozji. Wiele badań poświęcono aby stworzyć produkt, który można użyć więcej niż raz.

Label: Tool_FireStarter_Description
ENG: Shoot a fireball that deals {1}[I]Injury and applies [P]{2}[/P][Burn]Burn to enemies hit.
PL: Wystrzel kulę ognia zadającą {1}[I]Zranienia i nakładającą [P]{2}[/P][Burn]Podpalenia trafionym wrogom.

Label: Tool_FireStarter_DescriptionDetailed
ENG: Shoot a projectile that travels up to 8m. Upon hitting an enemy, it deals {0}[S]Stagger. It then explodes, dealing {1}[I]Injury and [P]{2}[/P][Burn]Burn to nearby enemies.
PL: Wystrzel pocisk lecący max 8m. Po trafieniu we wroga zadaje {0}[S]Zachwiania. Następnie eksploduje, zadając {1}[I]Zranienia i [P]{2}[/P][Burn]Podpalenia pobliskim wrogom.

Label: Tool_Decoy
ENG: Decoy

Label: Tool_Decoy_FlavorText
ENG: Tools that affecting the enemy's mind are pretty much unheard of. And yet, tools such as these started appearing all over the continent a few years ago, suggesting an outside influence.

Label: Tool_Decoy_Description
ENG: Jump back and create a decoy, causing all enemies currently targeting you to start attacking it instead. The decoy has {0}[H]Health and lasts up to {1} seconds.

Label: Tool_VeilOfShadows
ENG: Veil of Shadows

Label: Tool_VeilOfShadows_FlavorText
ENG: Control over shadows is a subset of Enforcer techniques just like any other. As if to prove that theory, even tools such as these were created, further proving the point that the shadowy monarch is not a god, but just a particularly powerful entity.

Label: Tool_VeilOfShadows_Description
ENG: Gain {0}[Barrier]Barrier and enter [Stealth]Stealth for {2} seconds.

Label: Tool_VialOfPoison
ENG: Vial of Poison

Label: Tool_VialOfPoison_FlavorText
ENG: Medicine and poisons are two sides of the same coin. It should be no surprise that this tool is yet another part of the Salutis repertoire, making sure that their mission is carried out no matter the means employed.

Label: Tool_VialOfPoison_Description
ENG: For the next {0} seconds, all [D]Damage dealt with your current weapon applies {0}[Poison]Poison per hit.

Label: Tool_IceCoating
ENG: Ice Coating

Label: Tool_IceCoating_FlavorText
ENG: Some substances can carry incredible amounts of energy imbued with a specific element. This particular liquid can only be found near the center of the Glacies region, instantly freezing any Energy Core it comes into contact with, thus requiring expert handling.

Label: Tool_IceCoating_Description
ENG: Next time you deal [D]Damage with currently equipped weapon, you will apply extra {0}[Freeze]Freeze.

Label: Tool_FirstAidKit
ENG: First Aid Kit

Label: Tool_FirstAidKit_FlavorText
ENG: Not all wounds can be sufficiently mended with the healing potions carried around by Combat Experts. Malicious after-effects of enemy techniques especially require more attention than simply drinking some liquid.

Label: Tool_FirstAidKit_Description
ENG: Start restoring {0}[H]Health and removing 1 debuff each second. Taking [D]Damage (aside from Damage over Time) causes this action to end.

Label: Tool_ThoughtAccelerator
ENG: Thought Accelerator

Label: Tool_ThoughtAccelerator_FlavorText
ENG: The Tonitrui specialize in all sorts of accelerations, but despite being inventors, the art of rapid thinking seemed to be beyond their reach. But being inventors, they did not simply throw up their hands and give up, and instead created this specialized tool.

Label: Tool_ThoughtAccelerator_Description
ENG: Remove {0} seconds from each [Technique]Technique [Cooldown]Cooldown and [Effect]Effect [Cooldown]Cooldown.

Label: Quest_UpgradeMaterials
ENG: Upgrade Materials
PL: Materiały do Ulepszania

Label: Quest_UpgradeMaterials_FlavorText
ENG: This mineral allows to 'cheat' the crafting process, upgrading the equipment's power without requiring any crafting talent. Money alone is often not enough to acquire it.
PL: Ten minerał pozwala na 'oszukanie' procesu tworzenia, ulepszając moc ekwipunku bez wymagania talentu twórczego. Same pieniądze często nie wystarczą, by go pozyskać.

Label: Quest_ToolMaterials
ENG: Tool Research
PL: Badania o Narzędziach

Label: Quest_ToolMaterials_FlavorText
ENG: Allows Alex to expand his arsenal of useful tools, either by improving their quality or increasing the amount he can carry. Unlike weapon upgrades, this progress is not lost upon entering a new cycle.
PL: Pozwala Alexowi na rozszerzenie jego arsenału przydatnych narzędzi poprzez poprawienie ich jakości lub zwiększenie ilości, którą może na raz mieć pod ręką. W przeciwieństwie do ulepszeń broni, ten postęp nie jest tracony w nowych cyklach.

Label: Quest_FirstMissionMap
ENG: Map to Laura's Shipment
PL: Map do Przesyłki Laury

Label: Quest_FirstMissionMap_FlavorText
ENG: This map shows where Laura's stolen shipment is. Since you memorized the location, there will be no need to get this map in further cycles.
PL: Ta mapa pokazuje gdzie jest skradziona przesyłka Laury. Jako że zapamiętałeś jej lokację, nie będzie potrzeby zdobycia tej mapy w przyszłych cyklach.

Label: Quest_HalfStiletto
ENG: Half Stiletto
PL: Pół Sztylet

Label: Quest_HalfStiletto_FlavorText
ENG: This blade won't work properly without finding its other twin, which should still be somewhere in Trimvine.
PL: To ostrze nie będzie poprawnie działało, póki nie znaleziony zostanie jego bliźniak, który nadal powinien być gdzieś w Trimvine.

Label: Quest_TrimvineKeyToLaurasLab
ENG: Key to Laura's Study
PL: Klucz do Pracowni Laury

Label: Quest_TrimvineKeyToLaurasLab_FlavorText
ENG: This key opens the reinforced door below the back entrance to Laura's Workshop.
PL: Ten klucz otwiera wzmocnione drzwi poniżej tylnego wejścia do Warsztatu Laury.

Label: Quest_FirstMissionKeyToChest
ENG: Chest Key
PL: Klucz do Skrzyni

Label: Quest_FirstMissionKeyToChest_FlavorText
ENG: Judging by the shape and quality, this key opens a specially energy-locked chest.
PL: Sądząc po kształcie i jakości, ten klucz otwiera skrzynię chronioną przez unikalny mechanizm energetyczny.

Label: Effect_Detailed_Description
ENG: Some effects and abilities have complex effects.\n\nIf you are interested in knowing exactly how they work, you can hover over such icons get the full explanation instead of the shortened version.

Label: Effect_Riposte_Description
ENG: [Riposte]Riposte: performed by using block just before an enemy's regular attack hits you

Label: Effect_Counter_Description
ENG: [Counter]Counter: performed by using the correct method between block, backstep or roll against enemy's [Counter]Counterable attack

Label: Effect_Block_Description
ENG:
[Block]Block: performed by holding [BlockButtonPress], it allows to convert all [I]Injury taken into [S]Stagger ([R]15%[/R] of original [I]Injury).

In addition to that, [Block]Blocking lowers all [S]Stagger taken by [P]40%[/P], making it much more effective against attacks inflicting [I]Injury rather than [S]Stagger.

When [Staggered]Staggered, [Block]Blocking only allows to take [R]50%[/R][I]Injury instead of full amount, making [Riposte]Ripostes, [Counter]Counters and [Dodge]Dodges a much more effective alternative.

Label: Effect_Dodge_Description
ENG:
[Dodge]Dodge: performed by pressing [DodgeButtonPress], it allows to temporarily avoid all attacks aside from some [Counter]Counterable and all [Unstoppable]Unstoppable.

Moving while pressing [DodgeButtonPress] will result in a roll, countering enemy [Counterable]Special thrust attacks.

Standing still while pressing [DodgeButtonPress] will result in a backstep, countering enemy [Counterable]Special swinging, down-to-up attacks.

Effects that trigger on [Dodge]Dodge only work if any [D]Damage is succesfully avoided.

Label: Effect_Unstoppable_Description
ENG: [Unstoppable]Unstoppable: some enemy attacks are so powerful that they cannot be [Counter]Countered or [Dodge]Dodged. The only option is to run from the line of fire

Label: Effect_BasicAttack_Description
ENG: [BA]Basic Attack: performed by pressing [BasicAttackButtonPress] using currently equipped weapon.\n\nHoliding [BasicAttackButtonPress] causes a Strong [BA]Basic Attack to be performed ([D]Damage and attack type improve with higher attack count)

Label: Effect_Magic_Description
ENG:
[Magic]Magic: some [Technique]Techniques deal [MD]Damage dependant on [Magic]Magic instead of [Weapons]Weapon stats.

[Proprius]Power Without Limit and [Proprius]Mind Over Matter stances allow to use [BA]Basic Attacks that scale with [Magic]Magic instead of currently equipped weapon.

[Magic]Magic [AS]Attack Speed is capped at 2.0.

Label: Effect_Weapons_Description
ENG: [Weapons]Weapons: you can use [Heavy]Heavy, [Light]Light and [Ranged]Ranged weapons, each assigned to their respective stance. Damage dealt by [BA]Basic Attacks and some [Technique]Techniques is dependant on your [Weapons]Weapon stat values

Label: Effect_Backstab_Description
ENG: [Backstab]Backstab: performed by pressing [BasicAttackButtonPress] while facing an enemy's back. Has special animation and higher [D]Damage, but cannot be used again against the same enemy until their [ImmunityToBackstabs]Backstab Immunity wears off

Label: Effect_Technique_Description
ENG:
[Technique]Technique: performed by pressing [Ability1ButtonPress], [Ability2ButtonPress], [Ability3ButtonPress] or [Ability4ButtonPress] and paying corresponding [E]Energy.

Cannot be used again until used [Technique]Technique's [CD]Cooldown wears off.

Different [Technique]Techniques have different [E]Energy costs, [CD]Cooldowns, special effects and scale with different stat values ([HD]/[LD]/[RD]/[MD])

Label: Effect_Heavy_Description
ENG:
[Heavy]Heavy Weapons: Greatswords, Longblades and Polearms.

In general, tend to have higher base [S]Stagger than [I]Injury and below average [AS]Attack Speed.

[Heavy]Heavy Weapons [AS]Attack Speed is capped at 1.5

Label: Effect_Light_Description
ENG:
[Light]Light Weapons: Twin Blades, Daggers, Gauntlets.

In general, tend to have higher base [I]Injury than [S]Stagger and above average [AS]Attack Speed.

[Light]Light Weapons [AS]Attack Speed is capped at 2.5

Label: Effect_Ranged_Description
ENG:
[Ranged]Ranged Weapons: Guns, Bows, Cannons.

Require [Ammo]Ammo to perform [BA]Basic Attacks (but not [Technique]Techniques).

[Ammo]Ammo is restored at the end of combat, by defeating enemies or through various special [Effect]Effects.

[Ranged]Ranged Weapons [AS]Attack Speed is capped at 2.0

Label: Effect_Sharp
ENG: [Sharp]Sharp
PL: [Sharp]Ostrość

Label: Effect_Sharp_Description
ENG: [Sharp]Sharp: [Riposte]Ripostes and [Counter]Counters deal more %[D]Damage based on the effect's value (stackable)

ENG: Titled, 'Penance: 200 Years of History', this seems to be a book about history of the continent.
